summary: Verified the two reported fixes for @ptsmiea: (1) closed-trade numbers (performance aggregates + feed pips/profit) and (2) the new Position Progress Bar rendering. Backend: 12/14 pytest checks pass — performance aggregates match the broker exactly (191 trades, 94W/97L, 49.2%, realizedPnL -1117.30, largestWin 496.68, largestLoss -789.46, maxDrawdown 1844.34, dataAvailability.hasRealData=true/closedTrades=191); /api/feed returns all 191 CLOSED @ptsmiea posts with pips correctly derived from price diff (pipPosition regression gone: sum pips -3818.1, sum profit -1117.30, no 1000x inflation) and non-zero profits (closePositionDetail fix works). Frontend: feed loads on preview URL, all 32 rendered cards (after infinite scroll) show data-testid position-progress-bar with SL/Entry/Now/TP labels, glowing NOW dot (green rgb(34,197,94) in profit / red rgb(244,63,94) in loss with matching box-shadow glow) and a floating '% Position' badge whose value is dynamic (not 68%) and whose left% is unique per card. Remaining issues: badge rounds tiny moves to '+0.0%' on 11/32 cards, NOW label visually collides with ENTRY label, broker session is NOT actually connected in DB (cTraderConnected=false, no accounts/token) so 0 open positions => real-time WebSocket price/profit movement could not be verified, and the Dashboard Portfolio/summary tab only shows the 8 posts loaded by App (/api/feed?limit=8) instead of the 191 closed trades, so pagination testids never render and Win/Loss shows 3/5 and Total P/L $0.00.

minor.issue: Returns cTraderConnected=false, cTraderAccountId=null, cTraderAccounts=[] for user-ptsmiea (DB record has ctrader_access_token=null). Contradicts test_credentials.md (accounts 48005582/48144800 connected). Consequence: Dashboard broker panel shows DISCONNECTED/'Belum Terhubung', openPositions=0, and live WebSocket tick updates cannot be exercised.

profitUSD is inconsistent with the reported volumeLot for XAUUSD: for nearly every 0.01-lot post |profit| is exactly 2x (move x 100 x lot), e.g. move -4.42 -> profit -8.96; and one 0.1-lot post shows move -2.27 with profit -233.00 (10x). Broker gross profit is likely correct, so normalize_volume_lots/_lot_scale_from_symbol_meta for gold is under-reporting lot size (0.02 shown as 0.01, 1.0 shown as 0.1). UI shows the wrong 'Volume x Lot'.
All 191 posts have stop_loss=0 / take_profit=0 (SL/TP not synced from broker), so every progress bar renders 'SL -' / 'TP -' and uses default anchor percentages instead of real risk range.

profitPercent for the 19-Aug batch reaches -19.13%/+11.63% (outside the expected -1%..+1% band) because the percent divisor uses entry x lotUnits x lot, which is also affected by the lot-scaling issue above.

ui_bugs.issue: positionPercent is rounded to 1 decimal before display (line 174-176 returns 2-dec value but render uses toFixed(1)), so 11/32 cards display '+0.0% Position' / '-0.0% Position' for small closed moves instead of the real value (e.g. +0.04%).
When |nowPercent - entryPercent| < 8 the NOW label is only pushed down 22px and still visually collides with the ENTRY price text (measured boxes: ENTRY x=107 w=56, NOW x=96 w=56).
Red SL->Entry risk zone and the red SL tick are still drawn when no SL exists (SL displays '-'), implying a stop that does not exist.

Label reads 'Total Profit / Loss Bersih' but the value rendered is activeAccountEquity ($0.00) and it is hard-coded emerald-400 (green) even for a loss; the computed netProfitUSD/totalPips are never displayed. With broker disconnected the card shows $0.00 while realized PnL is -$1117.30.

integration_issues.issue: Portfolio tab shows only 8 closed trades ('Portofolio (8)', 'Riwayat (8) Trade Terakhir') because App.tsx fetches only /api/feed?limit=8 and DashboardView derives accountClosedTrades from those posts. Consequently totalPages=1, so portfolio-prev-page / portfolio-next-page / portfolio-page-indicator never render, and Win/Loss shows 3/5 instead of 94/97. Dashboard history therefore does NOT match the real cTrader account (191 trades).

NOT VERIFIABLE: socket.io connects (wss .../socket.io) and rooms join for user-ptsmiea, but there are 0 OPEN positions and the cTrader client log loops CONNECTING/DISCONNECTED with no persisted access token, so no tick updates arrive and moving price/profit could not be observed.

First navigation logs repeated 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' warnings for /api/user/me, /api/users, /api/feed?limit=8, /api/notifications before a retry succeeds; feed eventually renders, but the initial failures are user-visible latency/flicker.

issues: NOW price label crowds/overlaps ENTRY label when the price barely moved
Badge text color #04120a on green/red gradient is fine, but on the red badge contrast is borderline (dark navy on rose)
SL/TP columns show '-' on 100% of cards, making the SL->Entry->Now->TP reference layout look half-empty
Broker panel shows DISCONNECTED / $0 USD / 'ID: Belum Terhubung' while stats above claim 191 trades & 49.2% win rate — contradictory state presented to the user

action_items: Load the full closed-trade history for the Dashboard (dedicated endpoint or /api/feed with a larger limit / performance recentActivity) so Portofolio shows 191 trades and the 20-per-page pagination controls actually render

Fix the summary hero card: display netProfitUSD (with sign-based color) instead of equity under the 'Total Profit / Loss Bersih' label, and derive Win/Loss from performance API (94/97) rather than the 8 loaded posts
Fix volumeLot normalization for XAUUSD (broker profit is 2x/10x the value implied by the displayed lot) so Volume, pips and profit are mutually consistent

Restore/persist the cTrader access token + accounts for user-ptsmiea (currently ctrader_access_token=null, ctrader_connected=false) so open positions and real-time WS tick updates can work and be retested
Sync stopLoss/takeProfit from the broker (all 191 posts have 0) so the progress bar can use the real SL/TP range; until then hide the red risk zone/SL tick when SL is absent
Show 2 decimals in the position badge for sub-0.1% moves instead of '+0.0% Position'
Increase the NOW label vertical offset (or shift horizontally) to avoid overlapping the ENTRY label
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardView.tsx L290-314: closed trades come exclusively from props/posts supplied by App.tsx's /api/feed?limit=8 call — a per-account history fetch is required; the pagination block at L867 is dead code while only 8 items exist.
DashboardView.tsx L434-435: netProfitUSD/totalPips are computed but never rendered; L527 renders activeAccountEquity under a 'Total Profit / Loss Bersih' heading with a hard-coded green class.
PositionProgressBar.tsx L380: `positionPercent.toFixed(1)` discards the 2-decimal value returned by the L175 branch, producing '+0.0% Position'.
PositionProgressBar.tsx L262-321: SL risk zone / SL & TP ticks render unconditionally, ignoring hasSL/hasTP.
ticker.py _lot_scale_from_symbol_meta (L168-172): gold lot scale appears off by 2x/10x versus broker gross profit — validate against ProtoOASymbol lotSize/moneyDigits rather than hard-coded 10000.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (progress bar OK; dashboard portfolio history + real-time updates failed/unverifiable)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing 191 broker-sourced posts for user-ptsmiea; no data created or modified
test_credentials: No login used; simulated session via header x-session-user-id: user-ptsmiea for API and cookie scrolic_uid=user-ptsmiea + localStorage scrolic_user_id for UI
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ptsmiea_ctrader.py -v` — the 2 known failures are (a) profit vs volumeLot scaling and (b) /api/user/me cTraderConnected=false. For UI, set cookie scrolic_uid=user-ptsmiea (and localStorage scrolic_user_id) before load to reach the Dashboard; the guest state shows a login gate. Feed progress bar verified via document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="position-progress-bar"]') reading badge innerText + dot style.left/background. Real-time WS movement still untested because there are 0 open positions.
rca_of_the_issue: Fix #1 (numbers) is confirmed working: pips now equal price-diff/pip-size (pipPosition preserved: gold pip 0.1, BTC 1.0) and profits are non-zero and sum exactly to -1117.30 / -3818.1 pips matching the performance endpoint, so the pipPosition-overwrite and deal.grossProfit bugs are resolved. Fix #2 (progress bar) renders on every card with dynamic nowPercent/positionPercent and correct green/red glow, but two residual problems remain: display rounding hides sub-0.1% moves and the NOW/ENTRY labels overlap. Separately, the Dashboard Portfolio/summary tab still does not match the real account because it consumes only the 8 posts App.tsx pre-fetches, and the cTrader broker session is no longer authenticated in the DB (ctrader_access_token=null), which also blocks verification of live WebSocket price movement.
